content:
anna_sales: RFI from AstroHealth — they want a 4-week Dedicated POC, capability matrix for embeddings+chat, KMS/HSM details, and SOC2 evidence. I uploaded their PDF: astro_rfi_morning.pdf. Need a tight draft by COB tomorrow.
jordan_se: For POC sizing, recommend 2x A10 baseline. They mentioned bursts ~200 QPS. If they confirm, perf will run synthetic loads.
maria_ps: I'll own perf. Ask them for a sanitized sample corpus or we generate a representative synthetic workload. Also need target p99.
anna_sales: On pricing: can we give a provisional 4-week POC rate + conversion option to reserved capacity? I need a ballpark for the RFI.
jordan_se: Provisional stub: 2x A10 baseline & managed ops ~ $45k for 4 weeks. Conversion to Reserved available; exact T&Cs subject to finance/legal. I'll draft language.
sam_security: Security note: Hosted supports tenant key separation; Private supports KMS/HSM via partner integrations (CloudHSM/YubiHSM). HSM is available only on Private with contract addendum. Will prepare appendix.
legal_lee: Don't imply FedRAMP authorization. Provide controls mapping and a partner plan. For SOC2, we can share Type II for current scope; if new scope, share interim attestations and timeline.
maria_ps: Capability matrix draft (paste):

```
Feature,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
Embeddings,Yes,Yes,Yes
Chat/LLM,Yes,Yes,Yes
Private KMS,No,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Optional(Private),Partner req'd
SLA,Standard,Enhanced,Enterprise
Fallback policy,Region spill,Policy-driven,Policy-driven + notice
```

anna_sales: Need a one-paragraph fallback example for their RFI. Also mention BAA for PHI.
jordan_se: Fallback paragraph draft: "Primary dedicated pool handles traffic; sustained queueing (>85% utilization for 2 min or median queue >5s) triggers: 1) burst nodes, 2) cross-region failover if allowed, 3) model fallback to a smaller variant with client notification headers. Circuit-break thresholds configurable in Console." Use as-is or edit.
sam_security: I'll attach security questionnaire answers and KMS appendix. Note: HSM claims need legal addendum.
doc-bot: Uploaded: astro_rfi_pack_v1.pdf -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/1766600000/astro_rfi_pack_v1.pdf
anna_sales: Plan: I will request sample corpus + SLOs, assemble the draft with provisional pricing and the attachments above, and send to AstroHealth COB tomorrow. Reviewers: @jordan_se @maria_ps @sam_security @legal_lee. Please comment here before 3pm PT tomorrow.
